text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(I will shine brighter than anyone. I will 
make sure I'm the one left standing!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah...! It's Chan, it's Aston Machan! 
The winner is Machan!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
M-My breath caught in my throat...! Even 
if I wanted to look away, I just couldn't!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
The moment she crossed the finish line, 
I... I ended up crying. Chan is just 
incredible.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...Last year was amazing. I still 
remember it."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was looking at Machan, smiling 
and giving a thunderous round of applause.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Still, right now—right now, it's even more 
incredible.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In everyone's eyes... ...a sparkling 
Chan-Mee is reflected.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for an unforgettable race, 
Chan-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I'm looking forward to your next race 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's Aston Machan. You remembered, didn't 
you?
